name: BUD
description: BUD (Bots Up Display) lets you talk to your Grok Bots from your G2: pick a bot, speak a task, and it is sent. Replies arrive as Grok Bot notifications. Zero retention: BUD's forwarder passes your request straight to your bot and stores or logs nothing. Your keys stay on your phone. Your voice goes directly to xAI with your own API key to become text. Approvals stay in the Grok Bot app.
author: cmdlabtech

permissions.name: network
permissions.desc: Sends your recorded voice directly to xAI to turn it into text. Sends the text, with the bot's webhook URL and sender key, to BUD's zero-retention forwarder, which passes it to your bot's Grok Bot webhook and stores or logs nothing.

permissions.name: g2-microphone
permissions.desc: Records a short voice message while you hold or tap to talk. The audio goes to xAI with your own API key to be turned into text.
